pick.headline: North Korean agents bomb South Korean delegation in Rangoon
pick.summary: On October 9, 1983, a bomb planted by North Korean agents exploded at the Martyrs' Mausoleum in Rangoon shortly before South Korean President Chun Doo-hwan was due, killing twenty-one people, among them four South Korean cabinet ministers.
pick.significance: Burma's investigation established North Korean responsibility and Burma broke relations with Pyongyang. It was one of the boldest state-sponsored assassination attempts of the Cold War.

alternates.headline: Seventy thousand march peacefully in Leipzig
alternates.summary: On October 9, 1989, some seventy thousand people marched in Leipzig after the Monday prayers for peace, and the security forces did not intervene.
alternates.significance: The decision not to shoot broke the East German regime's will; within six weeks the Wall was open.
